name: btprintdesigner
description: Label designer for thermal/Bluetooth printers with a faithful 1-bit preview (TSPL, ZPL, CPCL)

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm exec --workspace=@btpd/app -- electron-builder --mac zip --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm exec --workspace=@btpd/app -- electron-builder --win portable --x64 --arm64
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@btpd/core && npm run build --workspace=@btpd/app
